import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_90/training_9.csv",
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables by concatenation
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
df_union['admit'] = df_union['admit'].astype(int)
df_union['gre'] = df_union['gre'].astype(int)
df_union['gpa'] = df_union['gpa'].astype(float)
df_union['prestige'] = df_union['prestige'].astype(int)

# Assign to target table name
Target9_90 = df_union

# Write the result to the specified path
Target9_90.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_90/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
